architecture: Source-first finite semantic frame parser and typed proof renderer. No NLI/self-audit score grants eligibility; no exact-text/lexical-overlap admission.
generation: Reuse all previous raw drafts; only20 new questions each receive one greedy generateChat draft with unchanged BoundAnswer template,CPU6threads,4096context,320draft tokens within512total budget. No autoregressive self-audit; remaining192tokens unused. No prompt/seed search.
rules: One implementation before observing new outputs. Full generated factual text must parse into subject/relation/object/condition facts; unknown tails or qualifiers withhold whole claim. Controlled families: geography capital/largest/coast/superlative, process inputs/products and required-growth/removal events, written/codified definition conditions, time event begin/continue distinction, temperature usual/strict-bound, magnitude ratio/root and quantified observing roles. Values are extracted from source text, never case/entity/title allowlists or builder labels. Source anaphora only from explicit bounded article/definition antecedents, with antecedent spans attached. Formula root degree/radicand parsed structurally from TeX; decimal comparison uses displayed rounding precision, never proves wrong root. Claims retain all prose; citation references derive from matched source frames and exact offsets.
limits: At most6 source passages and existing1200-character sentence window per passage,8claims and8refs each; reject proof exceeding8refs; no unbounded parsing or partial-clause publication. Shared Java cancellation before/within every stage.
validation: Freeze20newqueries plus20constructed probes. Replay old103 records from prior classifier experiment without new generator or classifier inference. Measure every eligible claim support/completeness/usefulness independently of frame matches. Quality>4/40useful old,zero unsupported eligible,all9old and2new absent withheld; negative result remains failing. Test role/time/condition reversal, unknown tails, namespace/corruption/cancellation, formula bracket identity and deterministic same-relation entity substitution.
limitations: Finite parser covers a narrow English subset; parsed frame equality is not a general natural-language entailment proof. Builder source review and independent criticism remain necessary. No production model/admission changes or Android selected-model claim.
